name: Boostly – Conversion Booster for WooCommerce
author: WebTend

sections.description:
Boostly is a modular conversion toolkit for WooCommerce. Enable only the modules you need — each one is independent, so disabled modules load zero CSS or JavaScript.

Instead of installing multiple plugins for Quick View, Sticky Add to Cart, Direct Checkout, Trust Badges, Free Shipping Bars, and Sales Notifications, Boostly combines essential conversion-focused features into one lightweight and modular solution.

Enable only the modules you need. Disabled modules load no CSS or JavaScript, helping keep your WooCommerce store fast and optimized.
📖 Full Documentation

8 Modules Included

  • Quick View — Modal product preview with AJAX add to cart and variable product support.
  • Direct Checkout — One-click Buy Now button that skips the cart and goes straight to checkout.
  • Sticky Add to Cart — Floating bar with thumbnail, price, quantity and ATC button that appears on scroll.
  • Free Shipping Progress Bar — Animated goal bar to motivate larger cart values.
  • Sales Notifications — Recent purchase popups. Real orders, virtual entries, or a mixed mode.
  • Stock Scarcity Messages — Two-tier urgency messaging for low stock and critical stock states.
  • Recently Viewed Products — Horizontal carousel powered entirely by localStorage. No server overhead.
  • Trust Badges — Payment and security badges below Add to Cart. 12 inline SVGs. No external CDN.

Why Boostly?

  • Modular — Toggle each module independently. Disabled modules add zero overhead.
  • Lightweight — Vanilla JavaScript, scoped CSS, no frontend framework. Under 15KB per module on average.
  • Performance-first — Assets load only on pages where a module actually renders.
  • WooCommerce-native — Built entirely on WooCommerce hooks and template standards. Full HPOS compatibility.
  • Variable product support — All applicable modules handle WooCommerce variable products out of the box.
  • Translation-ready — Every string uses proper WordPress i18n functions.
  • Privacy-aware — Recently Viewed uses localStorage only. Sales Notifications supports virtual entries.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the boostly-for-woocommerce folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install via Plugins → Add New.
  2. Activate the plugin. WooCommerce must be installed and active.
  3. Open Boostly in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Enable the modules you need and configure each one individually.
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my site?

No. Only active modules load assets, and only on the pages where they render.

Does Quick View work with variable products?

Yes. The modal shows variation selectors with full AJAX add-to-cart support.

Does Sticky Add to Cart work on mobile?

Yes. Mobile and desktop visibility are independently controlled per module.

Are Trust Badges loaded from an external server?

No. All 12 SVG badges render inline. There are zero external requests.

Is this GDPR-friendly?

Yes. Sales Notifications can run on virtual names only. Recently Viewed Products uses localStorage and never sends viewing history to a server.

Is Boostly compatible with WooCommerce HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage)?

Yes. Boostly declares full HPOS compatibility.
